_schemaNote: Canonical teacher/student language registry, derived from docs/foundation-release-1/TEACHER_LANGUAGE.md. Lessons reference entries by id; lesson-specific custom wording lives in the lesson file itself, never here.

teacherPrompts.stage.see: What do you SEE? / What do you notice? / What are we being asked?
teacherPrompts.stage.break: What can we BREAK apart? / Is there a friendlier number hiding in here? / How could we split this up?
teacherPrompts.stage.build: What are we trying to BUILD? / What does that give us?
teacherPrompts.stage.transform: Can we TRANSFORM this into something easier? / What stayed the same? What changed? / Did the value change?
teacherPrompts.stage.check: How can we CHECK it? / How do you know? / Can you show it another way?
teacherPrompts.cross.same-changed: What stayed the same? What changed?
teacherPrompts.cross.value-changed: Did the value change, or just the way it's written/shown?
teacherPrompts.cross.show-another-way: Can you show it another way?
teacherPrompts.cross.friendlier-number: Is there a friendlier number hiding in here?
teacherPrompts.cross.conservation-check: Did we add or take away anything, or just look at it differently?
teacherPrompts.cross.reasonableness: Would the answer be bigger or smaller than that?

studentFrames.frame.same-value-different-form: I changed the form, but ___ stayed the same.
studentFrames.frame.makes-sense-because: I know my answer makes sense because ___.
studentFrames.frame.same-value-as: I can show the same value as ___.
